**Access boundary:** Public reading surface.

Implemented documentation candidate; production publication requires an explicitly authorized, independently verified release.

**Surfaces:** Public static engineering documentation with responsive 720/1440-pixel character-scene exports and small explanatory notes; no business API or authentication surface.

## Capabilities

<ol>
<li id="feature-71c266bdbf68">Dedicated engineering.guteneo.com reading surface built with Cloudflare Nimbus; customer documentation retains docs.guteneo.com; the shared four-language public footer links to the exact English-site URL under Resources after Developers without inventing localized engineering routes</li>
<li id="feature-59a579e56448">Curated English architecture, workflow and integration guides with local search, Markdown copies and assistant-readable indexes</li>
<li id="feature-1869942d88ad">Single-source feature tree with role permissions and customer journeys; feature changes update the registry and developer guide together</li>
<li id="feature-33377652b28d">Brand-colored Mermaid and isometric architecture diagrams with textual equivalents and explicit external provider boundaries</li>
<li id="feature-1a05013dbce0">Approved video Gutenberg character identity in small explanatory notes and three wide scenes: doctor for PDF diagnostics, architect for diagrams and archivist for the feature tree; no city panoramas or miniature stamp notes; header branding preserves original portrait alpha and its existing approved five-percent StampPaper white interior without an outer contour; other assets follow their actual inner blue frames rather than copying that inset, with ink-black light-mode and approved ivory dark-mode lettering, with reduced-motion support</li>
<li id="feature-a7a0336ce040">Asset-only publication from clean main matching fresh origin/main and the reviewed commit, with source snapshots and complete output hashes revalidated after browser checks; no business bindings or delivery authority; static no-transform responses preserve reviewed HTML/artwork bytes while hash-named Astro assets retain immutable caching; engineering checks all five public and built browser-icon files against the approved product family, with its helper/source paths bound to the release snapshot and unchanged matching Nimbus SVG plus ICO/PNG/Apple fallbacks</li>
<li id="feature-36c2610cdd03">Discoverable architecture diagram gallery with three brand-colored Mermaid flows, source downloads and accessible textual explanations</li>
<li id="feature-f8ef1441b020">Curated Belvédère administration, data-model, release and troubleshooting guides that preserve authority, evidence and recovery boundaries</li>
<li id="feature-a4baeee1802d">Maintained GitHub job/artifact/release explanation, fresh dependency boundaries and separate application/native/engineering evidence; every Ubuntu package installation, including engineering browsers, first prefers the runner's recognized official HTTPS archives while retaining signed package verification and the Azure fallback, and an unexpected mirror configuration fails closed</li>
<li id="feature-213043d2677b">Curated Cloudflare/Auth0/transport dependencies, background jobs, tariff maintenance, design/i18n/accessibility, AI contribution and reproducible video/voice production guides</li>
<li id="feature-ccbf884be9f3">Origin-scoped system/light/dark selection uses guteneo.theme with pre-paint resolution, cross-tab/system updates and optional migration of a prior ui-mode choice; Nimbus data-mode styling, fixed blue chrome, script-free system fallback and readable ivory dark branding grant no account or operational authority</li>
<li id="feature-ddfd6c0a9e76">Three isolated browser shards for each desktop/mobile Chromium and iPhone WebKit profile, same-revision build artifacts and independent complete test-ID inventory accounting; exact skip declarations must remain in the discovered inventory and obsolete desktop exceptions are removed when Classic/V2 navigation runs on both profiles; no missing/duplicate shard, skipped required job, automatic retry or merged-main publication shortcut; V2 consent and fax-ceiling first fields share one trusted touch/keyboard or desktop fill with exact value/focus and pre-submit checks; V2 retains unchanged real GET responses and exact dispatch recipient, while fax preserves its original timing, typed decimal comma, normalized phone and 150-cent POST without refilling, logging recipients or claiming either unexplained historical Linux input loss was repaired</li>
</ol>
